It's a high-stakes battle for Senate and House control, with the 2026 midterm
election results starting to roll in. Democrats have flipped their first
Senate seat of the night with Roy Cooper's win in North Carolina, Senator Jon
Ossoff has defended his Democratic seat in Trump-loving Georgia, and
Republican Ashley Moody beat out the progressive Angie Nixon in Florida.

[WATCH NOW ON YOUTUBE LIVE](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m4UaAGFTPVs)

**Mehdi** and **Prem** are live **NOW** in Detroit**,** as we await results in
two of the most closely watched Senate races of the year: Michigan and Texas.
They're speaking to people on the ground at Michigan Democratic candidate
Abdul El-Sayed's headquarters, where we've already heard from former Senate
candidate **Mallory McMorrow** and former New York Congressman **Jamaal
Bowman**.

And we've got so much more coming up! Tune in on
[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/live/m4UaAGFTPVs?si=SPlole1H2E0ujaF0) or
[Substack](https://open.substack.com/live-stream/439232) **RIGHT NOW** to hear
from Dearborn **Mayor Abdullah Hammoud** , former Michigan R**ep. Andy Levin**
, and more!

Supporting our live election coverage are **Zeteo 's Swin Suebsaeng **in Ohio
to see Vivek Ramasawmy's gubernatorial campaign until the end, and **Andrew
Perez** in Maine to report if this is _finally_ game over for Sen. Susan
Collins. Safe to say, **Zeteo** has both you and the news covered this
election night.
